speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and uveitis, I suspect a specific inflammatory condition rather than a simple infection. Does the ulcer have raised, violaceous borders, and have you noticed any joint pain or new eye symptoms recently?

speaker: Doctor
text: The history of an insect bite triggering this ulcer with violaceous borders, combined with your Crohn's disease and uveitis, strongly suggests Pyoderma Gangrenosum. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum
